ns2:course.label: Industrial Design II
ns2:course.description: Second term of the introductory level year of the Industrial Design MFA degree program. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. Prerequisite: ARTD 501.
